additive_within_1_5x.claim: an additive request code matches the fused code within 1.5x per-request rollout error at t = 225

interaction_decision_value.claim: axis interaction in the request code carries measurable decision value
interaction_decision_value.contrast: fused - additive, grid, nine-fixed-request mean AUC
interaction_decision_value.demonstrated_claim: the trained fused parameterization outperforms the trained additive parameterization on fixed-request mean grid AUC
interaction_decision_value.qualification: fused - additive changes the trained parameterization and its optimization as well as the interaction capacity, so interaction-specific decision value remains unidentified. The small fused FiLM interaction share neither proves nor disproves a decision-relevant interaction effect, and factored - additive does not isolate the removal of the fused model's interaction

rollout.metric: engine_position_mse (#100) at min(t, last frame), every mixed grid candidate

fused.source: Gate-B handoff checkpoints (#112 v3 retrain, LC hybrid); J = the #101 J
